name: r1-dispatch-noapp-manual-scoped
description: Scoped manual valve commands with CHIRPSTACK_APP_ACTUATORS empty (record with --scoped through the noapp oracle wrapper, replay Go with env -u CHIRPSTACK_APP_ACTUATORS). live-authorize queues the REJECTED_PERMANENT ACK for a scope refusal first; live-transport then answers transport_unavailable before it looks at the dispatch error.
